FROM ESTATE TO LISTENING ROOM

ORIGINS.

Four stages of Indian highland Arabica — roasted in small batches and poured beside corner-loaded horn speakers.

01

Ratnagiri Estate

Shade-grown Red Catuai & SLN 9 cherries harvested at 1,350m in Chikmagalur, fermented 72 hours anaerobically for spiced cacao depth.

02

Cast-Iron Roast

Every Tuesday we charge our 5kg cast-iron drum roaster, stretching Maillard browning to unlock toasted jaggery without bitter char.

03

18-Hr Nitro Steep

Cold-extracted in triple-filtered mineral water for 18 hours, then charged with food-grade nitrogen for a cascading velvet microfoam head.

04

Rajpur Road Listening Room

Sunlit espresso bar by morning; warm acoustic vinyl room by dusk. Pull up a booth on Rajpur Road as full LP sides spin uninterrupted.
